title: The dashboard's button to begin a notification reads "Start a new notification" and is a GOV.UK start button; Design release 1 uses a standard button reading "Create a new notification"

finding.frontend: The dashboard shows a green start button reading "Start a new notification" with the chevron icon, rendered with isStartButton (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/template.njk:30-33, text from src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/copy/copy.en.js:7). It is the tallest thing on the page and is the pattern GOV.UK reserves for the entry point to a whole service.
finding.prototype: Design release 1 shows a standard button reading "Create a new notification" directly under the heading (app/views/dashboard.html:32-36). It carries no start-button icon and no extra height, so it reads as one action among several on a signed-in landing page rather than as the front door to the service.
finding.difference: Change the label to "Create a new notification" in src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/copy/copy.en.js:7 and drop isStartButton from the call at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/template.njk:30-33 so it renders as a standard button. The form around it stays: the frontend creates the notification with a POST and Design release 1 uses a link, which is an implementation difference and not part of this change.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a govuk-button--start class or the words "Start a new notification" on the captured dr1-dashboard screen.
finding.verification: Ran the falsifier: govuk-button--start and "Start a new notification" both match 0 times in dr1-dashboard.html, and govuk-button--start matches once in fe-dashboard.html. Read src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/template.njk:30-33 (form wrapping govukButton with isStartButton: true) and copy/copy.en.js:7, against app/views/dashboard.html:32-36 (a plain govukButton with text "Create a new notification" and href "/create-notification", no start modifier). Opened both dashboard screenshots — the tall green chevron button on Frontend, a standard-height button under the heading on Design release 1. CORRECT.
